goal: Work a queue of four real incidents using a repeatable five-question triage method that identifies the failure phase before the cause, then inspect node and control-plane health strictly read-only.
produces: Four diagnosed and repaired workloads: an image-pull typo, a CrashLoopBackOff exiting 127, a Pending Pod the scheduler refused, and a Service whose selector matched nothing
A completed triage worksheet recording, per ticket, the first failing question, the decisive command, the root cause and the fix
A reusable decision tree plus an exit-code reference the learner can carry into the practical assessment
concepts: Phase before cause: scheduled, pulled, started, ready, endpoints — stop at the first NO
Schema-valid is not working: the API server accepts all four broken manifests, so every failure is a runtime failure
Match the tool to the phase — describe and events for scheduler and kubelet decisions, logs --previous only once a container has run, EndpointSlice for routing
Control-plane components are static Pods with no controller, no validation and no undo; diagnose with /readyz?verbose and kube-system logs, and never write
